name: Tearing mode
blurb: A Harris current sheet with resistivity: the field reconnects across it and the sheet tears into a chain of magnetic islands (Furth, Killeen & Rosenbluth 1963). The growth rate depends on the Lundquist number a v_A / eta, here 500: the islands grow for a few time units, then saturate and merge slowly, while the sheet itself diffuses wider. The reconnection setups follow the taranis WebGPU reduced-MHD page of Mallet & Abraham (alfredmallet.github.io/taranis/webgpu/rmhd2d.html).
